'''Nosli Tilbruk''' was an [[Abednedo]] who worked as an unlicensed [[courier]] in [[Olega City]] on the [[planet]] [[Olega]] during the [[High Republic Era]]. By [[132 BBY]], he was aged and needed [[computerized navigoggles]] to aid him in navigating the [[city]]'s streets as his memory was fading. That [[Standard year|year]], he hit the [[Sith assassin]] [[Mae-ho Aniseya]] with his [[C/L-22 Karozzin]] [[landspeeder]] near the [[Olega Jedi temple]], but when he got out the [[speeder]] to check if she was ok, she threw him to the ground and stole the vehicle to escape [[Skirmish on Olega|arrest]] by [[Jedi]].

==Biography==
{{Listen3|NosliTilbruk-Attacked-RevengeJustice.flac|Nosli Tilbruk grunting then shouting|Nosli Tilbruk grunts as he moves to help Mae-ho Aniseya then shouts as she throws him to the ground}}
[[File:NosliTilbruk-AcolyteVG.png|thumb|right|300px|alt=Wearing a glowing pair of computerized navigoggles, Nosli Tilbruk sits behind the wheel of his C/L-22 Karozzin landspeeder on the streets of Olega City.|Nosli Tilbruk worked as an unlicensed courier.]]
Nosli Tilbruk was an [[Abednedo]] who was a long-[[time]] resident of the [[planet]] [[Olega]]'s [[capital]], [[Olega City]], during the [[High Republic Era]]. He worked as an unlicensed and independent [[courier]], driving a [[C/L-22 Karozzin]] [[landspeeder]] through the [[city]], even including the oldest neighborhoods where landspeeder traffic was rare because the congested streets could barely accommodate the vehicles.<ref name="AcolyteVG" />

In [[132 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TheAcolyteDate}}</ref> Tilbruk was driving the [[speeder]] on errands near the [[Olega Jedi temple]]<ref name="AcolyteVG" /> when he hit the [[Sith assassin]] [[Mae-ho Aniseya]] with his speeder as she fled from [[Jedi]] [[Skirmish on Olega|attempting]] to arrest her. Aniseya tumbled over the front of the speeder and landed in the dirt beside it, while the Abednedo was jolted back in his seat as he stopped the vehicle. Seeing her on the ground, he hopped out to check on Aniseya, gripping her [[Limb|arm]] as she began to stand, but the [[assassin]] grabbed him with her other hand and span him behind her while throwing him to the floor. Staying on the ground, Tilbruk began to crawl away slowly as Aniseya climbed into the speeder.<ref name="RevengeJustice">{{Acolyte|Revenge / Justice}}</ref>

[[File:NosliTilbruk-Mae-RevengeJustice.png|thumb|left|300px|alt=Nosli Tilbruk stands beside his blue C/L-22 Karozzin landspeeder hunched slightly as he moves to check on Mae-ho Aniseya, who is slowly getting up from the ground in one of the streets of Olega City.|Nosli Tilbruk hit Mae-ho Aniseya with his landspeeder.]]
The assassin's twin, [[Verosha Aniseya]], then emerged from a nearby alley, and the siblings stared each other down before Verosha fired a [[stun]] bolt at Mae-ho but missed. The assassin then started the speeder and raced away past Tilbruk as Verosha fired another shot that went wide. By this point, the Abednedo had stopped crawling and was writhing on the ground in front of a doorway, out of which a [[human]] emerged and moved to check on Tilbruk.<ref name="RevengeJustice" />

==Personality==
Given the amount of time that he had lived in Olega City, Nosli Tilbruk saw himself as an exception to the unwritten rule that landspeeders avoided the old parts of the city with congested streets.<ref name="AcolyteVG" /> By [[132 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the [[Color|brown]]-skinned Abednedo was advanced in age, and his memory was beginning to fade, requiring [[computerized navigoggles]] to help him negotiate the tangled warren of overlapping alleys in thoroughfares in Olega City.<ref name="AcolyteVG" /> Upon hitting Mae-ho Aniseya, he stopped and quickly moved to check if she was alright and help her up.<ref name="RevengeJustice" />

==Equipment==
When he hit Mae-ho Aniseya, Nosli Tilburk was wearing his gray and red computerized navigoggles with a green [[scarf]], a patterned tan [[jacket]] with no sleeves, a magenta [[Clothing|shirt]], yellow, fingerless [[glove]]s, brown [[boot]]s, brown pants, and a dark blue [[cape]].<ref name="RevengeJustice" /> He drove a blue and purple C/L-22 Karozzin.<ref name="AcolyteVG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nosli Tilbruk appeared in "[[Revenge / Justice]],"<ref name="RevengeJustice" /> the second episode of the live-action [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'', which aired on [[June 4]], [[2024]].<ref name="Announcement">{{SW|url=news/the-acolyte-teaser-poster|text=''The Acolyte'' Teaser Poster, Premiere Date Revealed}}</ref> The character was not identified in the episode<ref name="RevengeJustice" /> but was named in the [[2025]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="AcolyteVG" />
